name: Web server (host): Probe of a sensitive path
description: A request for a file or page attackers look for: .env, .git, backups, wp-admin, phpMyAdmin, actuator and similar, in the nginx / Apache / OpenResty / lighttpd / Traefik access log in the common or combined format of the host (*.log in /var/log/nginx, apache2, httpd, lighttpd, caddy, traefik). The source is the client address the log names (X-Forwarded-For: its last address, what the outer proxy saw; the rest is client-controlled).
